💡 Vibe-Trading | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a comprehensive and intelligent platform for individuals to engage in algorithmic trading, backtesting, and market analysis through a personal trading agent.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-agent trading system • AI-powered trading strategies • LLM integration for trading insights • Backtesting capabilities • FastAPI backend
📖 Summary: Vibe-Trading is a Python-based personal trading agent that empowers users with comprehensive trading capabilities. It leverages multi-agent systems, AI, and LLMs to facilitate algorithmic trading, backtesting, and market analysis through a FastAPI backend and React frontend.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 claude-ads | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and auditing paid-media operations across multiple advertising platforms with a focus on safety, control, and data integrity.
✨ Key Features: • Source-grounded audits with dated evidence and explicit confidence • Campaign planning for channels, budgets, measurement, and experiments • Creative asset generation briefs (copy, image, video)
📖 Summary: Claude Ads is a Python-based, Claude-first paid-media operations tool designed to automate and audit advertising campaigns across 12 major platforms. It provides source-grounded audits, deterministic scoring, versioned reports, and capability-gated account changes, prioritizing safety and control.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 web-check | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Website analysis for open-source intelligence (OSINT), security assessment, and performance optimization.
✨ Key Features: • IP info • SSL chain analysis • DNS records • Cookie inspection • HTTP headers
📖 Summary: Web-Check is a comprehensive OSINT tool written in TypeScript that analyzes websites to provide detailed insights into their security, technology stack, and performance. It helps users understand, optimize, and secure their web presence by uncovering potential attack vectors, server configurations, and associated hostnames.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 Neoflow | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time collaborative brainstorming and design on a digital whiteboard.
✨ Key Features: • Free Forever • Open Source • Fun & Easy • AI Integration • tldraw Powered
📖 Summary: Neoflow is an open-source, real-time collaborative whiteboard application built on the tldraw engine and powered by Next.js. It offers a user-friendly interface with AI integration to enhance creative workflows for teams and individuals.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
